text:
Priya (CS): Hey team — putting up a short customer-facing Activation Checkins Matrix that ties account health signals to specific onboarding actions and a tiny ops runbook for caching/batching/streaming. Draft here: https://redwood-internal/drive/activation-matrix-draft

Luca (SE): Skimmed — looks great. Can we make the recommendations action-oriented? e.g., 'If avg latency > 250ms -> enable streaming + reduce batch size to 4' rather than generic tips.

Aisha (PM): +1. Also add a one-line 'what not to change' section for customers (helps support avoid breaking warm pools).

Tom (SRE): Quick note: for Dedicated customers, call out that autoscale cooldowns can mask transient signal spikes. Suggest 10m lookback for renewal-risk signals.

Priya (CS): Good call. I added a 1-line FAQ about cooldowns. Draft excerpt below — thoughts on wording?

Priya (CS): ```
Signal: sudden drop in successful completions (>= 5% over 1hr)
Immediate action: open help desk + enable prefix cache for hot prompts (TTL 2h)
Operational tweak: reduce continuous batch size to 2 for 30m, enable streaming fallback for p50 latency > 200ms
Customer message: "We're seeing increased errors; temporarily routing requests to streaming-compatible variant to keep UX responsive."
```

Luca (SE): Love the concrete steps. For the 'enable prefix cache' line can we give them the CLI snippet? small code helps customers move faster.

Luca (SE): ```bash
# enable prefix cache for tenant 1234
redwoodctl tenant update 1234 --cache.prefix=true --cache.ttl=7200
# reduce batch size on route 'chat'
redwoodctl route update --route chat --batch.max=2 --batch.window_ms=20
```

Priya (CS): Perfect, add that. Also adding a short 'when to escalate to renewals' checklist: repeated engagement drop over 7d, billing disputes, or >30% reduction in monthly tokens.

Aisha (PM): For the onboarding status table, can we include a colored matrix: green (healthy), amber (at-risk), red (escalate) and map 2-3 signals to each? Example:
- Green: p50 latency < 150ms, daily active queries stable +/-5%
- Amber: p50 150-300ms OR cache hit rate < 40% OR weekly active queries down 10-30%
- Red: p50 > 300ms OR repeated 500s OR weekly active queries down >30%

Tom (SRE): Suggest including a lightweight triage command for CS to run during bridge calls. Something like `redwoodctl tenant status 1234 --brief` that prints top 3 signals.

Priya (CS): I wrote a one-liner for that and a suggested script for capture during calls (3 bullets): 1) run triage, 2) snapshot last 24h latency/cost, 3) ping engineering with trace id.

cs-bot: New draft uploaded to /drive/activation-matrix-draft (version 3) by Priya.

Luca (SE): One more ops-best-practice: recommend customers keep a small warm pool + a rolling prefetch for top-10 prompts during launch windows. Phrase it as optional but recommended for >1M monthly tokens.

Priya (CS): Added as 'recommended for high-throughput tenants' with a short config example. Also added a tiny section on feedback capture: include a single shared Google Sheet with 'time, sample prompt, observed output, customer note' — keeps evals simple.

Aisha (PM): Can you add a short script snippet for anonymizing prompt text in that sheet? lawyers will thank us.

Luca (SE): ```python
# naive redaction for shared feedback sheet
def redact(prompt):
    return prompt[:60] + '... [redacted]'
```

Priya (CS): Nice. I'm going to pilot this doc with two mid-market accounts this week and iterate. If no objections I'll publish a trimmed customer-facing PDF and a companion internal checklist for CS engineers.

Tom (SRE): No objections from infra. Add a note that customers on Private deployments may need to coordinate KMS/HSM changes for runbook actions that touch keys.

Priya (CS): Will do. Thanks everyone — pushing version 3.1 after lunch. :raised_hands:
